verdict.rationale: Bolt documents a GitHub integration that can create a new repository from a Bolt project and keep an automatically synced, full-history backup "that lives outside Bolt". That is a real first-party route for getting the source code out. The docs never describe running or self-hosting that exported code elsewhere; Bolt's own hosting docs cover only bolt.host and custom domains. missing for 10: documented direct download/ZIP export, guidance on running the exported app locally or on third-party hosts, independent hands-on confirmation that exported code runs outside Bolt.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform
